raw_response:
This barley plot is a good size, and since I rented it I need to make it produce well to cover the rent. I will put fertilizer on it like most of us do with barley — probably the DAP at planting and some urea later, though I cannot afford the full package. I will stick with my own seed from last year's harvest because improved barley seed is hard to find here, and I will add some manure from my animals where I can carry it. The weeding will be heavy on 2.29 hectares, so I will need to hire a few people at weeding and harvest time alongside my family.
